name: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Rice
steps: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and toss with the cornstarch.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken until browned and cooked through with no pink inside.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir for thirty seconds until fragrant.
Add the broccoli with a splash of water, cover, and steam for three minutes until just tender.
Pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything to coat, and serve over the cooked rice.
